name: Sunny Harbor
description: A calm and welcoming harbor, perfect for beginners to learn the ropes.

name: Murky Swamp
description: A boggy, overgrown swamp just past the harbor, full of strange little critters.

name: Misty Lake
description: A quiet lake shrouded in fog, home to a variety of freshwater fish.

name: Rushing River
description: A fast flowing river cutting through the hills, tricky to fish but rewarding.

name: Sandy Coast
description: Sun soaked shores where the sea meets the sand.

name: Frozen Tundra Lake
description: A frigid lake locked in ice for most of the year, home to hardy cold water fish.

name: Open Ocean
description: Vast open waters, home to bigger and bolder fish.

name: Volcanic Vents
description: Scalding waters bubbling above a chain of undersea volcanic vents.

name: Deep Sea
description: Dark, cold waters far from shore where strange creatures lurk.

name: The Abyss
description: The deepest, darkest waters known to anglers. Only the bravest dare fish here.

name: Floating Sky Lake
description: A legendary lake said to float among the clouds, reachable only by air.
